name: micro-fe-prototype
description: A micro frontend: the world shell lazy loads the rick and morty remotes over module federation, plus jerry, a guest remote from another repo, every app on its own React 19 and wouter

scripts.start: bun scripts/ports.mjs check && bun run build && bun run serve
scripts.dev: bun scripts/ports.mjs check && concurrently -k -n world,rick,morty -c blue,green,yellow "bun run --cwd world dev" "bun run --cwd rick dev" "bun run --cwd morty dev"
scripts.build:netlify: export MFE_TARGET=netlify && bun run build && bun scripts/assemble-dist.mjs
scripts.serve: bun scripts/ports.mjs check --built && concurrently -k -n world,rick,morty -c blue,green,yellow "bun run --cwd world preview" "bun run --cwd rick preview" "bun run --cwd morty preview"
